changelog:
* **refactor: fold draft card into the General settings group** (9ed2085)
  - Draft link is now a SettingsGroupRow inside the General card after Currency
  - Keeps the red-dot badge when drafts exist and the draft-count subtitle
  - Removes the standalone DraftLinkCard composable
  - SettingsGroupRow gains an optional badge param
* **feat: separate English and Bangla fonts** (1b66e0c)
  - English UI now renders in the device system sans-serif (Roboto, Google Sans, etc.)
  - Bangla UI keeps Tiro Bangla with the exact same styles as before
  - CashFigureTheme gains an isBangla flag; MainActivity passes the existing language state
  - English PDF reports use the system default typeface; Bangla PDFs keep Tiro Bangla
  - typography styles are now built from one appTypography(fontFamily) helper
* **fix: naturalize Bangla translations across the app** (f766099)
  - Rewrite all Bangla UI strings to read as natural, everyday Bangla.
  - Replace robotic loanwords: ডাটা→ডেটা, রিস্টোর→পুনরুদ্ধার, ভার্সন→সংস্করণ, প্রিভিউ→দেখুন.
  - Use মন্তব্য for the remarks field so it no longer collides with banknote নোট.
  - Unify variants (সব/সকল/সমস্ত) and sentence punctuation with the danda (।).
  - Revise Cash Breakdown to বিস্তারিত হিসাব and update the README settled-terms table.
  - Mark the README translation section as revised instead of work-in-progress.
* **feat: show saved draft count as draft page header** (1227bec)
  - Replace the Cash Breakdown heading with a single count line: 1 draft saved for one, N drafts saved for more.
  - Match Bangla with N টি ড্রাফট সংরক্ষিত আছে for any count.
